convention: conditional Wu-Palmer difference is NARROW minus EXACT (positive = NARROW errors closer to gold)
proximity_scope: LLM reranker and LLM generator errors pooled across the three Spanish benchmarks; this is not the equal-cell all-system estimate reported in conditional_proximity_by_benchmark.csv
_note_prox_diff_legacy: prox_diff below is the legacy EXACT-minus-NARROW value (-0.0114); use prox_diff_NARROW_minus_EXACT
_note_persystem: within-NARROW sibling credit share (wup-weighted) per system; the pooled-LLM narrow_credit_share (0.62/0.64/0.66) is rerank+gen; SapBERT/fine-tuned SapBERT are ~0.47-0.51 on DisTEMIST (around half, not a clear majority) but 0.66-0.73 on MedProcNER/SympTEMIST
